title: Private requests
description: Dietary and access needs told in confidence. Only people given this specific access see them.
retention: Requests delete themselves 30 days after the occasion is closed out.

empty.title: No private requests
empty.body: Guests can send one from their link, in the “Private request” section. Send them their invitations from the Guests page.

list.title: Requests
list.noteLabel: Note for you and others with this access
list.noteHint: For example: spoke with the chef.

share.title: Send only numbers to a supplier
share.intro: The supplier gets lines such as “3 × gluten-free” in the briefing. No name, no household, no text written by guests.
share.submit: Send the numbers into the briefing
share.sent: Published as version {version} of the briefing.
share.nothing: There are no numbers to send yet: the requests have no dietary tags and there are no access needs.
share.noSuppliers: This occasion has no suppliers yet.
share.managersOnly: Only the organisers can publish into a supplier's briefing.

guest.title: Private request
guest.intro: Do you have a dietary or access need? Tell us here. Only the organisers appointed for this read it — not other guests, not suppliers.
guest.bodyHint: For example: nut allergy; I need a ramp at the entrance.
guest.childWarningTitle: It looks like you wrote details about a child
guest.childWarningBody: A child's name or age is not needed — the need itself is enough (“one gluten-free meal”). You can remove the details or send as it is.
guest.sent: Your request has reached the organisers.
guest.sentNote: For discretion, the text is not shown here again after sending.

export.title: Private requests (CSV)
export.description: Only for people with access to private requests.

errors.kind: Choose what the request is about.
errors.empty: Write a few words or choose a diet.
errors.tooMany: You have already sent several requests. For anything else, write to the organisers directly.
errors.nothingToShare: Tick at least one number to send.
errors.alreadyShared: The briefing already has these numbers.
